purpose: Claude dependency audit and bounded KITTI development pilot (2026-11-09, base 9794d81). Fixed before any perceptual distance or detector output was computed. Not a performance test; G0 pending.

near_duplicate_audit.population: all 4,006 normal-condition reference images (paths containing a *_ref split)

representation.primary: 64-bit pHash: PIL grayscale (L), LANCZOS resize to 32x32, orthonormal 2-D DCT-II, top-left 8x8 block, bit = coefficient > median of those 64 coefficients (DC included)
representation.secondary: 64-bit dHash: PIL grayscale, LANCZOS resize to 9 wide x 8 high, bit = right pixel > left pixel; recorded for every flagged pair, never used to add flags
representation.input_check: raw-byte SHA-256 and size of each decoded reference compared against the manifest (the bytes are read once for decoding; no separate 8,012-file hash pass)

near_duplicate_audit.review_unit: one representative image pair (closest pHash, then dHash) per unordered cross-component pair; cross-condition component pairs first, then same-condition, each by distance
near_duplicate_audit.rules: Flags and visual labels are proposals. No primary component is merged automatically. Confirmed and uncertain edges feed separate sensitivity counts. Exact-byte edges stay primary; the 449 cross-condition images stay descriptive-only.

kitti_pilot.selection_rule: sort every image_2 *.png file name by SHA256(seed + ':' + file name), ties by name; take the first 32. No labels or detector outputs are read.
kitti_pilot.models_and_environments: configs/smoke/smoke_config.json (weights, SHA-256, repo commit, config); Ultralytics in det-eval-2d/.venv and RT-DETRv2 in ar-work/venv-rtdetrv2, both read-only

execution_hold.rule: No automatic unlock or scheduled run; original caches are historical evidence, not a runtime certificate.
